Removing Acer Care Center after Installing AcerSense
By
Chantal-Acer
Last Updated:
Mar 20, 2024
Can Acer Care Center be deleted after AcerSense is installed?

You may want to uninstall the Acer Care Center software after you install AcerSense to free up some system resources. The AcerSense software incorporates most major Acer Care Center features, so it is not required to have both installed. To uninstall the Acer Care Center software, follow the steps below.

How to uninstall Acer Care Center
Click on Start ⊞.
Click on All Apps.
Right-click on the Care Center app, then click on Uninstall.
